onset.Description: The raw stimulus onset. Note that there were 11TRs before the first vignette was shown which is why the onset of the first event is at ca. 7.92secs

duration.Description: The duration the vignette was on screen.

trail_type.Description: The mft foundation/mac category of the vignette.

pres_order.Description: The order in which the stimuli were presented (1-24).

stim_file.Description: The name of the image file that was made from the slide with the vignette on it.

vigtext.Description: The specfic text that was shown on the vignette.

cond_id.Description: The vignette number within its condition. This is useful for item-level analyses.

vig_id.Description: The unique identifier (0-119) for each vignette item
